findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Hybrid keyword + semantic search over the public pages of vascue.io: healthcare-operations guides, the AI front desk for clinics, provider-side insurance-claims…

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "search" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: search · Public sink: search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: search · Public sink: search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
